submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 35 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 94.028% at the allocated 8 kHz rate. This represents a significant improvement over the other candidates: Algorithm-L3 achieves 85.404% and Algorithm-L2 achieves 74.388% at the same threshold. Through systematic testing of thresholds from 30-40 GeV, 35 GeV was identified as the optimal operating point for Algorithm-L1, providing approximately 2-3% higher efficiency than neighboring thresholds. All three algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget and have sufficient optical link bandwidth, making Algorithm-L1 the clear choice for maximizing physics performance.
